title: Thread inventory
description: meta/threads.json. Read from /proc/<pid>/task before and after the run, so it costs nothing and works even when every eBPF probe fails. Feeds the viewer's Threads table.

clk_tck.description: sysconf(_SC_CLK_TCK) on the target host, needed to interpret utime/stime.

threads.description: Keyed by tid as a decimal string.

first_seen.description: 'start' when present in the pre-run snapshot, 'end' when the thread appeared during the run.

exited.description: True when the thread was present at start and gone at end.

schedstat.description: /proc/<pid>/task/<tid>/schedstat: time on CPU, time waiting on a runqueue, timeslices run. Null when the file was unreadable (CONFIG_SCHEDSTATS off).
